name: osint_recon
description: OSINT reconnaissance: harvest emails, subdomains, and IPs for a target domain using theHarvester and passive DNS.
author: james-linux

params.command: dig {{domain}} ANY +noall +answer && dig {{domain}} MX +noall +answer && dig {{domain}} NS +noall +answer && dig {{domain}} TXT +noall +answer

steps.description: DNS record enumeration (A, MX, NS, TXT)
